(i) soft-switching is a key factor for the reliability of the converter; (ii) standard commercial devices are not suitable for soft-switching; (iii) specific devices for soft switching are needed; (iv) a specific test equipment for the reliability assessment of soft-switching devices has been developed.
the soft-switching conditions are not suitable for all MOSFET devices, and that a specific device is required to improve the reliability of the converter.

the development of an innovative test equipment for the investigation of the reliability of MOS transistors, in soft switching conditions, in order to evaluate the influence of the gate drive and of the body diode turn off on the MOSFET lifetime.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
soft-switching is a good technique for improving the converter reliability, but the reliability of soft-switching MOSFETs must be improved as well.
soft-switching is a reliable solution for power converters, provided that specific devices are used.
the soft-switching operation, in particular the reverse recovery of the body diode, can be considered the main cause of device failure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reliability of MOS power devices in soft-switched converters is mainly influenced by the power losses in the body diode, and by the gate turn-off power losses.
soft-switching is an efficient way to reduce the switching losses in a converter, but a proper selection of devices is mandatory to avoid reliability issues.
, in the soft-switching operation, a MOSFET device has a higher risk of failure if the reverse recovery current of the body diode is high and the device is operated at low junction temperature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
soft-switching operation is not a reliability problem per se, but it is the gate turn-off that can lead to device failure, if not properly designed and implemented.
the reliability of the MOSFETs can be significantly improved by reducing the power dissipation during the gate turn-off phase.
the gate driver plays a key role in the reliability of the device, and that a proper gate driver design is essential to improve the device lifetime in soft-switching applications.
